response: The proliferative index obtained by DNA image cytometry does add prognostic information in Auer IV breast cancer. According to ICM-DNA values corresponding to the S + G2/M region, patients with breast cancers classified as Auer IV can be divided into subgroups with different tumor characteristics and prognoses. This suggests that DNA image cytometry can provide valuable information to help predict the outcome and guide treatment decisions for patients with Auer IV breast cancer.
